description: A report as JSON: the overall score, each engine's runs mentioned of runs total, competitors named instead, cited sources, the fix list and, per question, how many usable answers named the product. Answer texts are left out to fit your context: pass question (1-based: 1 is the first question, the number each summary entry shows) to read that question's answers and citations. Engines in enginesSkipped did not run; never describe them as not mentioning the product. simulated: true means test data. Free.

question.description: 1-based question number, as the summary shows it: 1 is the first question, n the n-th. 0 is deprecated and also reads as the first question (older agents counted from 0), so 0 and 1 return the same question.

slug.description: The slug from a previous call.

name: recomention_report_get
